title: Moonlight on the Magic Flute
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to a grand summer palace in 1762 Vienna. With a magic silver flute, they help a tiny, stubborn boy named Wolfie — who turns out to be the young Mozart — find his way to sharing music with the world! 🪈

q.en: What city and country do Jack and Annie visit on this mission?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮这次的任务去了哪个城市和国家？

options.en: Madrid, Spain, from long, long ago

explain.en: Teddy and Kathleen tell them the royal party is at a summer palace in Vienna, Austria, in the year 1762.
explain.zh: 泰迪和凯瑟琳告诉他们，这场皇家宴会在1762年奥地利维也纳的夏宫举行。

q.en: What does the Wand of Dianthus change into for this adventure?
q.zh: 在这段冒险里，迪安瑟斯魔杖变成了什么？

options.en: A tiny leather drum, in a place far away

explain.en: Kathleen spins the wand into a small silver flute, shaped like a unicorn's horn, that can deliver them from danger when played.
explain.zh: 凯瑟琳把魔杖旋成一支小小的银笛，形状像独角兽的角；吹奏它能帮他们脱离危险。

q.en: Who is the little six-year-old boy who loves music and calls Jack a clown?
q.zh: 那个六岁、热爱音乐、还叫杰克“小丑”的小男孩是谁？

explain.en: The boy is Wolfie — short for Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart — who is six years old and later gives a piano concert at the palace.
explain.zh: 这个男孩是沃菲，也就是沃尔夫冈·阿玛多伊斯·莫扎特的昵称；他六岁，后来在宫殿里开了一场钢琴演奏会。

q.en: What is the name of Wolfie's older sister, who helps Jack and Annie in line?
q.zh: 沃菲的姐姐叫什么？她曾在队伍里帮助过杰克和安妮。

explain.en: Wolfie's sister is Maria Anna, whom everyone calls Nannerl or Nan; she is eleven and very kind to Jack and Annie.
explain.zh: 沃菲的姐姐是玛丽亚·安娜，大家都叫她南内尔或南；她十一岁，对杰克和安妮非常友善。

q.en: Who is 'Her Imperial Majesty' that Jack and Annie must bow to?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮必须鞠躬行礼的“女王陛下”是谁？

options.zh: 伊丽莎白女王，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: Her Imperial Majesty is Maria Theresa, the Archduchess of Austria and Empress of the Holy Roman Empire, who hosts the palace party.
explain.zh: 女王陛下是玛丽亚·特蕾莎，奥地利女大公、神圣罗马帝国皇后，正是这场宫殿宴会的主人。

q.en: What goes wrong for Jack when he bows to Her Imperial Majesty?
q.zh: 杰克向女王陛下鞠躬时，出了什么洋相？

options.en: He gets lost looking for the garden
He spills a whole pitcher of punch on an imperial child
options.zh: 他把一整壶潘趣酒泼到了一位皇室孩子身上，在很远很远的地方

options.en: His wig, hat, and flute all tumble out and he slips
options.zh: 他的假发、帽子和笛子全掉了出来，还滑了一跤

options.en: He performs a funny dance for the empress
options.zh: 他给女皇表演了一段滑稽的舞蹈

explain.en: While bowing, Jack's silver flute slips out, then his hat and wig fall off, powder makes him sneeze, and he slips to his knees as the court laughs.
explain.zh: 鞠躬时，杰克的银笛掉了出来，接着帽子、假发也掉了，粉未让他打喷嚏，他滑跪在地，引来满堂哄笑。

q.en: Why are wild animals like a leopard and a bear roaming the palace garden?
q.zh: 为什么豹子、熊之类的野兽会在宫殿花园里游荡？

options.zh: 是魔笛把它们召唤来的

options.en: They escaped from a traveling circus, though that is another story
options.zh: 它们从巡回马戏团逃了出来，不过那是另一个故事了

options.en: Wolfie let them out of the palace zoo
options.zh: 沃菲把它们从宫殿动物园里放了出来

options.en: A storm blew the cages open
options.zh: 一场风暴把笼子吹开了

explain.en: Annie figures out that Wolfie freed the animals from the palace zoo, which Josef had mentioned was behind the palace.
explain.zh: 安妮推断是沃菲把动物从宫殿动物园里放了出来——约瑟夫之前提到宫殿后面就有一座动物园。

q.en: In which room does young Wolfie give his amazing piano concert?
q.zh: 小沃菲那场精彩的钢琴演奏会在哪个房间举行？

explain.en: Nan and Wolfie's father wait in the Hall of Mirrors, where Wolfie climbs onto a bench and plays the tune of the magic flute on the piano.
explain.zh: 南和沃菲的父亲在镜厅等候，沃菲爬上长凳，在钢琴上弹出了魔笛的旋律。

q.en: What is the name of Mozart's last great opera, mentioned at the end of the story?
q.zh: 故事结尾提到，莫扎特最后一部伟大的歌剧叫什么？

explain.en: When Jack looks up Mozart on the computer, he reads that Mozart's last great opera was called The Magic Flute — linking back to their own magic flute.
explain.zh: 杰克在电脑上查莫扎特时，读到他最后一部伟大的歌剧叫《魔笛》——正好呼应了他们那支魔笛。

q.en: According to the facts at the back of the book, at what age did Mozart begin writing his own music?
q.zh: 根据书末的事实介绍，莫扎特几岁开始创作自己的乐曲？

explain.en: The back-matter says Leopold began teaching Mozart at age three, but Mozart started writing his first compositions when he was only five.
explain.zh: 书末资料说利奥波德在三岁时开始教莫扎特，但莫扎特五岁就开始创作自己的第一首乐曲了。
